blocks.text: AI-powered website builder purpose-built for SaaS landing pages

Unicorn Platform focuses on one thing and does it well: helping SaaS founders create professional landing pages. While general-purpose builders try to be everything to everyone, Unicorn Platform is laser-focused on the startup use case - pricing sections, feature grids, testimonial blocks, and CTA-optimized layouts.

The AI writing assistant understands SaaS messaging patterns. Feed it your product description and it generates headlines, feature descriptions, and CTAs that follow proven conversion principles. It saves hours of copywriting iteration.

The blog and changelog features are thoughtful additions for SaaS teams. Your marketing site, blog, and product updates all live under one roof, maintaining a consistent brand without juggling multiple platforms.
Pre-built sections for pricing, features, testimonials, and more
Generate headlines, descriptions, and CTAs with AI assistance
Built-in blogging and product changelog for content marketing
Create tool directories and curated lists
Optimized static pages that load in under 1 second
Built-in page view tracking without external tools
The SaaS-specific templates and AI copy generation make this a no-brainer for solo founders. You get a professional-looking landing page in an afternoon instead of a week.
